notes: The complete abstract refutability surface is checked over arbitrary formula atoms and classical theorem predicates. A refutability operator carries exactly R1, and its base-theory conclusion transports to every stronger theorem predicate. The generalized diagonalization service constructs the Jeroslow sentence with its exact internal equivalence; a formula-local soundness capability proves that sentence unprovable in every consistent extension. Formalized safety is the negation of simultaneous provability and refutability. The source universal formalized law of noncontradiction is generalized to the sole property its proof uses: a formula together with specialization to safety at every sentence, removing quantifier syntax and Gödel coding. Formula-local formalized completeness makes the Jeroslow sentence imply simultaneous provability and refutability, and specialization of the formalized law yields its unprovability. This covers Refutability, R1 and its strengthening, the Jeroslow definition and both theory levels of its equation, local soundness, unprovability, safe/flon, jeroslow_not_safe, and unprovable_flon. Propositional excluded middle is used only to certify classical tautologies; no choice, extensionality, equality decision, first-order syntax, or coding assumption is required.

The complete abstract mathematical surface is checked over arbitrary formula atoms and theorem predicates: generic provability and dual iteration, the negated-iteration duality, one-step and arbitrary bottom-iteration monotonicity, unprovability of every iterate under Kreisel reflection and consistency, extended-natural height, its infinity and upper-bound characterizations, the positive base-theory soundness bound, the exact finite-height iff, infinite height under reflection and consistency, and zero height under inconsistency. Because Coq negation is implication to falsity rather than Foundation's structurally involutive NNF negation, neg_iterated_prov is represented by the exact theorem-level biconditional. The source full-HBL premise for boxBot_monotone and height_le_iff_boxBot is relaxed to D3 alone. Reusable ENat successor-order and zero-minimum lemmas factor representation case analyses. The remaining concrete adapters are ArithmeticTheory.height and its ISigma1/PA corollaries; they depend on the still-unported standardProvability construction and its arithmetic reflection instances.

The module's sole mathematical theorem is proved in the stronger abstract form pa_rosser_first_incompleteness: every consistent classical theorem predicate with a weaker diagonalizing base and a provability operator satisfying the Rosser condition is incomplete. The remaining adapter is the arithmetic instantiation showing that Foundation's concrete proof-comparison predicate supplies pa_provability and pa_rosser; that construction belongs to the still-unported RosserProvability.lean and WitnessComparison.lean layers.

All five source consequences are checked abstractly: consistency is unprovable, its negation is unprovable under Kreisel reflection, consistency is independent, and adjoining either formerly unprovable statement is strictly stronger via the factored pa_strictly_weaker_of_unprovable theorem. Both source undefinability theorems are checked in representation-independent form. For arbitrary formula atoms, every classical consistent theorem predicate extending a diagonalizing base rejects any formula endomorphism whose value is internally biconditional to each input; this subsumes substitution into a quoted unary arithmetic predicate. The semantic theorem further generalizes true arithmetic: it needs only the direction taking truth to theoremhood and the introduction direction for truth of biconditionals, not the converse, a full semantic model, arithmetic syntax, coding, or definability. The shared two-premise tautological consequence helper isolates the liar contradiction. Propositional excluded middle is the sole global principle.

The full consistent-sequent canonical model is checked using the shared proof-relevant positive-derivation preorder, including the empty top world and singleton worlds induced by unprovability. Ordinary forcing is propositional truncation of the Type-valued Hauptsatz forcing relation, while weak forcing specializes it along the Gödel--Gentzen translation; explicit generic intuitionistic and classical Kripke structures assemble their connective laws. The relational-atom converse invokes Hauptsatz to recover a cut-free witness. The complete finite-sublanguage reduction is checked. Generic predicate-selected sublanguages, their forgetful homomorphisms, and injectivity are explicit. Function and relation inventories are generalized from finite sets to duplicate-tolerant arity-indexed lists, eliminating decidable equality from collection and membership transport. Terms and formulas translate structurally into any selected sublanguage and map back exactly. A formula's source-facing finite language uses occurrence indices rather than proof-carrying subtypes: symbols are finite ordinals indexing the collected lists, so decidable equality and encodings are computational and require no proof-field equality or encoding of the ambient language. Decidable equality is needed only to number each original occurrence during translation. The forgetful map recovers the original formula exactly. Structures extend along any injective language homomorphism using one classical epsilon for function symbols outside the image; interpretations on image symbols, term values, and formula truth are exact. Consequently mapped semantic consequence is equivalent to the original consequence, and every satisfiable theory remains satisfiable after an injective language embedding. The occurrence-indexed construction is finite and therefore strengthens the source's merely encodable sublanguage conclusion.
